run.percentile_method: nearest-rank over successful measured loops: value at ceil(P/100*n), 1-indexed
run.timing: wall clock, time.perf_counter_ns on the client, per read and per loop
run.bytes: application-layer: request = the exec command string (ssh arms) or the JSON-RPC frame (mcp); response = stdout bytes (ssh arms) or the JSON-RPC frame (mcp); body_bytes = the kb --json output either way. Not wire bytes.
